Application Materials.content:
- An updated Resume
- Your official academic transcripts of all educational institutions attended.
- Certified True Copies of CFA / ACCA certificates (if any)
- 2 Personal Statements (approximately 500-600 words each) on the following topics:
1. Explain your career and personal aspirations, and your motivation for pursuing the MSc in Applied Finance (MAF) programme.
2. Discuss one of the following topics:
1. Describe your greatest weakness and how you have tried to overcome it.
2. Describe your outstanding talents, skills and inherent abilities that are not reflected in your academic qualifications and records.
- 2 Referee Reports - Submit 2 complete sets of referee details during the online process of applying for the SMU MAF. The application portal will automatically send an email to your referees and collect your recommendation forms on your behalf once you have submitted the application.
- Copy of NRIC/FIN/Passport (in PDF or JPEG format)
- Any other supporting documents
- Supporting documents can be delivered to SMU either by hand or by mail: **SMU Lee Kong Chian School of Business**, 50 Stamford Road Level 4 Graduate Programmes Office, Singapore 178899. Office Hours: Monday to Friday, 9.00am - 5.45 pm.
- To expedite your application process, applicants are encouraged to email a softcopy of their supporting documents after submitting their applications to [maf@smu.edu.sg](mailto:maf@smu.edu.sg).
- If certificates are certified 'true copies', applicants do not need to bring the originals for verification.
- If a foreign applicant's transcript is not in English, all documents must be translated to English and certified.
- Of the two personal references, one should typically be from a current or previous employer, a colleague, or someone else who knows you well at work; the other referee could be someone who taught you at university or college, or another person who knows you in a professional capacity. For fresh graduates, both referees can be your professors.
- Upon submitting your online application, a link will be sent to your referees via email to submit their recommendations online. Applicants are encouraged to notify their referees before or after submitting their online application to complete the online recommendation form.

Interview Requirements.content:
- Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an **online interview within two weeks** of the online application / application.
- As SMU practices rolling admissions, the admission process — submitting the application, **passing the interview with the Admissions Committee**, and accepting the admission offer — will typically take about **3 - 4 weeks** to complete.
- The programme conducts interview sessions to select each cohort of students.
- Only shortlisted applicants are invited for an interview.
- The admission interview is about **20 to 30 minutes**.
- Changing the date and time for the admission interview is subject to the schedule of the interviewer(s).
- Shortlisted applicants may check the status of the interview outcome via email from the Admissions Committee, and are encouraged to check their mailboxes regularly.

Academic Requirements.content:
- Pre-requisites include a **Bachelor's Degree**.
- Work experience is not required; fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
- Applicants should have a **good undergraduate degree from a reputable institution (in any field)**.
- The admission criteria include **a good university degree in ANY discipline**; applicants in the process of earning a degree and about to graduate are welcome to apply.
- Some working experience is preferred **for the Part-Time Track only**. Based on past intakes, part-time students typically have, on average, four to five years of working experience.
- Formal finance training/work experience is not a requirement: “All the courses require no previous formal training.” Applicants from all backgrounds and working experience are eligible to apply for the MAF programme.
- Applicants need to be numerate, rather than having particularly strong mathematical skills; they do not need an undergraduate degree in mathematics or the pure sciences. Some calculus will be required for certain modules in the programme.
- SMU graduates with cumulative GPAs of **3.0/4.0 or better**, and graduates from local Autonomous Universities (NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, SIT) with cumulative GPAs of **3.5/5.0 or better**, will not require a GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test Score for admissions. An undergraduate GPA is valid for 5 years after graduation. Meeting the above GPA academic criteria does not guarantee admission.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- Pre-requisites: Bachelor's Degree; **GMAT / GRE / SMU Admissions Test**.
- Application requirements include **a good GMAT / GRE / *SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT) score**.
- **SMU graduates with cumulative GPAs of 3.0/4.0 or better, and graduates from local Autonomous Universities (NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, SIT) with cumulative GPAs of 3.5/5.0 or better will not require a GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test Score for admissions.** An undergraduate GPA is valid for 5 years after graduation. Please note that meeting the above GPA academic criteria does not guarantee admission. Candidates may still be advised to submit GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test scores to further strengthen their application.
- If you have not taken the SMU Admissions Test/GMAT/GRE, you may first submit your online application and arrange for the test to be taken as soon as possible.
- The admission criteria include: **A good GMAT/GRE or SMU Admission Test score**.
- There is **no minimum GMAT/GRE score required**. However, to make your application more competitive, applicants are encouraged to achieve: **GMAT/GRE: 600 and above (with a strong Quantitative Score)**.
- All candidates are required to complete an admissions test for consideration. If you have not prepared for the GMAT or GRE, you may opt for the SMU Admissions Test instead.
- A GMAT score is valid for **five years after the test date**. GRE scores may be submitted instead of GMAT, and GRE scores are valid for **five years after the test date**.
- SMU's GMAT institution code for the MSc in Applied Finance is **F8D-7V-27**. SMU's GRE institution code is **2861**.
- If you took GMAT/GRE more than once, submit your **highest score** if the score is still within the 5 years validity period after the test date.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
- IELTS or TOEFL is required if the medium of instruction of your undergraduate studies was not English.
- To make your application more competitive, applicants are encouraged to achieve: **TOEFL: 95 (internet based test)**; **IELTS: 6.5 and above**.
- The TOEFL/IELTS test is required if the medium of instruction in your undergraduate education was not in English. SMU’s institution code for TOEFL is **9014**.
- Your TOEFL score is valid for **two years after the test date**.

Program Overview.content:
18-month duration (full-time); 24-month duration (part-time). Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
The industry-relevant curriculum of the Master of Science In Applied Finance (MAF) is designed to provide you with a strong foundation in the principles, practices and operations of international and domestic financial markets. Learn how to apply updated and relevant knowledge in real-world situations through internship opportunities in SMU's network of more than 3,000 companies worldwide.
As a collaborative partner with Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) Institute and Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst (CAIA) Association, the curriculum aligns with the CAIA and full CFA curriculum and is an ideal form of preparation if you wish to pursue your CAIA or CFA designation. Students will cover curriculum spanning CFA Levels 1 to 3 upon graduation.
Benefit from the experience and expertise of eminent faculty members with PhDs from top-ranked universities around the world. Gain valuable career insights from thought leaders with deep industry experience and network and share their passion for learning.
Students have the opportunity to specialise in Fintech, Fund Management, Real Estate or Sustainable Finance. Designed for flexibility, the MAF programme is available in both full-time (12 months + internship) and part-time (24 months) modes of study. Students are required to complete 15 Credit Units which include 9CU Core Modules, 4CU Elective Modules, 1CU Open Module (Internship or Capstone Project or MAF elective or other modules offered by other schools), 1CU Postgraduate Professional Development Course in order to be awarded the Master of Science in Applied Finance degree.
Class Profile: Gender 1:1; Average Age 25; International Students 81%; Nationalities 13; Average Years of Work Experience 1.8. Student profiles taken from Classes of 2018-2021 (Full-time & Part-time).
Industries that MAF Graduates Work In: Audit / Accounting 9%; Consulting 7%; Business / Financial Services 58%; Real Estate 3%; Technology 11%. Industry diversity data collated from graduating students from 2020 and 2021.
The MAF Part-Time track is an 20-month part-time course spanning over six terms at SMU. This track admits Singaporeans, Singapore permanent residents and foreigners holding a valid employment or a dependant's pass. The MAF Full-Time track is an 18-month full-time course, with the option to complete in 12-months. The programme spans over four terms at SMU, including internship option. This track admits Singaporeans, Singapore permanent residents and international students. All candidates will receive the same degree i.e. the Master of Science in Applied Finance degree, fully conferred by SMU.
The MAF programme was launched in 2002, offering only the MAF Part-Time track. The MAF Full-Time track was launched in July 2011.
To date, MAF graduates have been well sought-after locally and internationally. The programme provides a stepping-stone for those who want to enter the finance and banking industries. Most graduates venture into the fund management, banking and consultancy sectors.
All lessons and examinations are conducted in English for all the tracks under the MAF programme. A typical class size is about 50 to 60 students. The programme will be taught by well-qualified and experienced SMU and industry professionals. The syllabus is customised for the local and regional financial environment with international perspectives.

Curriculum.content:
The MAF programme is available in both full-time and part-time modes of study. It is designed for flexibility, with full-time listed as **12 months + internship** in the Programme Calendar and the FAQ describing the **MAF Full-Time** track as an **18-month full-time course, with the option to complete in 12-months**, spanning over four terms at SMU, including internship option. The **MAF Part-Time** track is described as a **20-month part-time course** in the FAQ and as **24 months** in the Programme Calendar.
Students are required to complete **15 Credit Units (CU)** to be awarded the Master of Science in Applied Finance degree:
- **9CU Core Modules**
- **4CU Elective Modules**
- **1CU Open Module**: Internship OR MAF elective OR other modules offered by other Schools
- **1CU Postgraduate Professional Development Course**
Students may choose to specialise in one of the following elective tracks: **Fintech, Fund Management, Real Estate or Sustainable Finance**. Students can opt to do any 4 elective modules from the list below or specialise in a track by completing 4 elective modules offered in the same track.
Programme calendar:
| Mode | Term 1 | Term 2 | Term 3 | Term 4 | Term 5 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Full-time 12 Months + internship | 5 Core Modules | 4 Core Modules | 4 Electives | 1 Open* Module | |
| Part-time 24 Months | 3 Core Modules | 2 Core Modules | 4 Electives | 2 Core Modules | 2 Core + 1 Open* Module |
| Full-time 15 Months + internship | 5 Core Modules | 4 Core Modules | 4 Elective | 1 Open* Module | |
| Part-time 20 Months | 3 Core Modules | 2 Core Modules | 4 Elective | 2 Core Modules | 2 Core + 1 Open* Module |
*The Open Module refers to an Internship OR MAF elective OR other modules offered by other Schools.

- Advanced Quantitative Methods & Economic Analysis

FAQ structure details: Students of the MAF programme are required to complete **9 core modules, 4 electives, and a career management skills course**. Exemption is not possible. Students are required to complete **9 core modules and 4 elective modules** to meet the requirements of a Singapore Management University (SMU) MAF degree. In order to graduate, students have to complete **all 13 modules**, maintain an overall GPA of 2.5 and above, and complete the SMU Postgraduate Professional Development Series (PDS). All lessons and examinations are conducted in English for all the tracks under the MAF programme.

Financial Aid.content:
Students may apply for SMU MAF Programme Scholarships upon admission. These scholarships entail award amounts up to **30% of the tuition fee**, with no bonds attached.
- **Academic Excellence Award**: offered to high-quality candidates with exceptional academic performance. Awards are based on academic merit, final grades and GMAT score. Tier One awardees must have achieved a GMAT of **720 or above** and demonstrated outstanding academic achievement. Tier Two awardees must have achieved a GMAT of **700 or above** and demonstrated outstanding academic achievement.
- **Global Awareness Award**: given to individuals who will contribute to classroom diversity and enrich the learning experience of students by way of cultural, personal or professional backgrounds.
- **Leadership Award**: recognises individuals who have exhibited outstanding leadership potential during their studies, or in their community or organisation. Applicants must demonstrate strong leadership potential in personal and professional instances; assessment includes interview performance, a 500-word essay, and leadership quality recognition.
- **Community Impact Award**: recognises candidates who have contributed to society through outstanding community work and impacted members of the community/society in a positive manner; assessment includes interview performance, an essay, and impact of community work.
- **Impact on Asia Award**: for students who can demonstrate achievements in professional, social and personal life that have created an impact on Asia; assessment includes interview performance, a 500-word essay, and impact.
- **Women in Business Award**: recognises exceptional women who have demonstrated outstanding leadership capabilities or potential in their professional or personal endeavours. Applicants must have successfully received an admissions offer.
- **AGL Irudayaraj Scholarship**: motivates outstanding postgraduates of Indian ethnicity at the University to greater heights of academic excellence; assessment includes interview performance and an essay on leadership experience, community involvement and financial need, if any.
- **Mapletree Postgraduate Scholarship**: funded by Mapletree for education and enhancing the Mapletree Real Estate Programme at the Lee Kong Chian School of Business. Scholarship awardees must be enrolled as a full-time or part-time student in the MAF programme and commit to complete the Real Estate specialization track within the MAF programme.
- **SkillsFuture**: SkillsFuture Funding is available for Singapore Citizens. The SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme provides Singapore Citizens aged 40 years and above the opportunity to receive the SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top up of **$4,000**, intended to offset out-of-pocket tuition fees starting from Academic Year 2024/25 intake, commencing on or after **1 May 2024**.
- **SMU Alumni**: graduates from SMU undergraduate or postgraduate programmes are automatically eligible for an alumni discount of **S$8,000** when applying to the MAF programme.
- **Singapore Local Autonomous University**: graduates from NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, or SIT are automatically eligible for an alumni discount of **S$4,000** when applying to the MAF programme. Eligible candidates may receive exemptions for up to four credit units, with a discount of **$3,000** awarded for each credit unit exempted.
- **SG/PR**: Singaporean citizens and Permanent Residents are eligible for a one-time discount of **S$5,000**.
- **ASEAN Citizens**: ASEAN citizens are eligible for a one-time discount of **S$3,000**.
- **Corporate Partner**: eligible company-sponsored candidates are eligible for a one-time discount of **S$6,000**.
The above discounts are applicable to students joining the programme from the **January 2025 intake onwards**. Each student is only eligible for one discount; should a student qualify for more than one discount, only the higher discount will be applicable. The tuition fee discount is deductable before Goods and Services Tax (GST).

Multiple Applications.content: I am interested in two programmes offered by SMU; do I have to submit two online application forms? You have to submit two online application forms.

Deferral Admission Policy.content: You may defer for a year only, and the candidature lapses automatically if you do not return the following year. If you have to defer your studies due to unforeseen circumstances, you will have to write in to seek permission from the Programme Director.
